changes: Permit Crop, Guided Transform, Local Adjustments and targeted tone/HSL at manual/Fill zoom. Preserve Fit-only sampling/retouch tools.
Use the same prepared document for rendering and preview pixel geometry: full uncropped Crop canvas and transform/crop-disabled Guided canvas. Stable tool rendering uses full source when zoomed.
Disable Flickable drag/TapHandler ownership while editing tools own the pointer; retain actual wheel/pinch zoom and pan.
Canvas backing stores cover only the viewport intersection, with translated source-space painting. Overlay positions include the actual Image offset.
contracts: Actual 100% and 137.5% controls, non-central pan in both axes, exact input-space Crop corner/Guide endpoint/Brush path and independent tone/HSL sample/delta checks.
Undo/Redo preserves one edit unit, Guided remains transient, source SHA256 unchanged. Crop/Guide grips must appear at the expected actual scene pixels.
Crop/Guide/Brush use a 3072x2304 source and require the genuine full-resolution provider size. Targeted uses 2048x1536 to isolate coordinate mapping from sampling downscale.
All active and inactive Canvas stores remain bounded at 1600%; this is geometry/allocation-size evidence, not GPU/RSS/load qualification.

limitations: The large repeated series has 3 Crop PASS and 9 FAIL. Eight availability failures explicitly observe actual OS MemoryPressure::warning; one reset after the initial normal snapshot has no conclusive transition trace. None is rewritten as PASS.

An earlier small-fixture series has one out-of-viewport Crop start (corrected fixture) and three availability failures without pressure instrumentation. The diagnostic repeat passes those three and retains the Crop failure.

The corrected small-fixture series passes 4/4. Current large native passes 4/4. Isolated offscreen passes the other three once after actual kernel normal preflight; the planned second isolated cycle did not start because real kernel warning persisted for 60 seconds. No callbacks were suppressed and no normal state was injected.
Local three-repeat coverage of all four large adapters is incomplete; hosted/native aggregate and full release gates remain open.
